messages.subject: Re: Unexpected input in Shiny R but unable to locate the unexpected input character
parts:
I believe that's a Byte-order mark (BOM). You should tell your editor to save without a BOM.

See this for more information:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3255993/how-do-i-remove-%C3%AF-from-the-beginning-of-a-file

Ideally though, Shiny would would detect the BOM and handle it correctly. I'll file an issue for that.

-Winston

messages.subject: Re: Unexpected input in Shiny R but unable to locate the unexpected input character
parts:
Yeah, that looks like the BOM. I'm hesitant to support BOM in shiny
because the Unicode standard does not recommend it
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Byte_order_mark). Saving a text file
without BOM using a functional text editor is fairly easy for users,
anyway.

It looks like your ui.r is purely ASCII, so there is no need to save
it with the UTF-8 encoding. I cloned the gist you mentioned but did
not find the BOM in it (perhaps Github has stripped it off). If
possible, please email the full app to us. Thanks!

Regards,
Yihui
